_note: DROP-IN RECIPE (owner only — never fabricate a citation). After running the monthly 6-engine sweep, for each engine cell that cited the hub set "cited": true and paste the source "url" (the shared chat/answer link, where one exists). Optionally add "quote": "..." (verbatim snippet / evidence, shown as a tooltip), "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", and "screenshot": "/images/...". Leave cells untouched (cited:false, url:"") where the hub was not cited, or where that engine has not run yet — they render as the neutral "–". Then set summary.totalCitations to the count of REAL cited cells and summary.lastUpdated to the date the sweep was run, and rebuild. Each query row targets one citable hub page (insight or discovery landing); append more query objects to extend the battery.
